description: A reference integration showing how an external service — an ERP, WMS or accounting system — authenticates with Orbit and runs a two-way sync from its own infrastructure.

permissions.description: Read orders that changed since the last sync, to send them to the ERP
Match ERP SKUs to Orbit products
Write ERP stock levels back onto Orbit products
Subscribe to order events so the sync is push-driven rather than polling
Check which subscriptions already exist, so restarts do not duplicate them
Required alongside webhook:create for order.* topics
